reason: I usually find roles through alumni and developer communities, so a job search tool with source coverage that I cannot evaluate upfront does not solve my main problem. Running it myself and setting up accounts or keys is more work than checking the original referral posts directly.
objection: I cannot tell whether its sources include the referral posts and countries where I look for roles, and self-hosting adds setup work.
would_change_my_mind: A no-key demo with a transparent list of supported countries and sources, including the original referral links I would use.
